plan.title: Treated vs control liver RNA-seq: descriptive fold changes
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a single gene-level raw count matrix from salmon (12,000 genes x 3 columns: gene symbol + 2 samples) plus a 2 x 2 metadata table, human liver, one treated sample and one control sample. This design has NO within-group replication, so no dispersion can be estimated and no p-value from a two-sample contrast has any inferential basis. The plan therefore answers the research question in the only defensible way: it does not run a differential expression test. T1S1 profiles the two libraries (library size, detection, blind VST, sample-to-sample correlation/distance) so that any technical asymmetry between the two libraries is visible before any fold change is read. T1S2 applies the standard low-count pre-filter, computes DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors, and produces a DESCRIPTIVE table of normalized counts and log2(treated/control) fold changes with control set explicitly as the denominator, ranked by effect size and flagged by expression level — explicitly labelled as hypothesis-generating, with no p-values, no adjusted p-values, and no 'differentially expressed gene' calls. T2S1 takes the full ranked gene list into a preranked fgsea run against human MSigDB Hallmark and then Reactome; because there is no inferential gene-level statistic, the ranking metric is the descriptive log2 fold change (stated choice under the disputed-metric rule, forced by the no-replication flag), and set-level p-values from this run are reported as descriptive ordering only, never as evidence. T1S3 assembles the report: what was and was not computed, the exact reason inference is withheld, the replicated design that would support it (>=3 biological replicates per condition), and the full reproducibility record. The single largest risk in this dataset is that a reader treats a large log2 fold change as a finding; every step is constrained to prevent that.

Low count filter: at least 10 counts in at least 1 sample
Explicit reference level control, contrast treated vs control
Descriptive log fold changes only, no inferential test
fgsea preranked GSEA ranked by descriptive log2 fold change, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
